senses.label: sequence / succession
evidence: the ordinary sense of a progression or order

senses.label: Krama technical usage / cognition-as-sequence
evidence: Sanderson: the pūjā-krama as a reflection of the saṃvit-krama

avoid: automatic capitalisation as a school where only the structure is meant
notes: Capitalise Krama ONLY where the school/doctrine is demonstrable (style guide §6).

senses.label: lineage / family
evidence: ordinary genealogical sense

senses.label: body / power / totality
evidence: the kaula development: lineage → body → power → totality; KMT mantradeha; TĀ 3.143 akula/kula polarity

avoid: rendering kula as 'family' where it means the totality/lineage-body
notes: kaula = the Kaula school; kula (structure) stays lowercase per style guide §6.

senses.label: the Goddess / consort
evidence: hypostasised divine power

senses.label: mantric power
evidence: the power of the mantra

senses.label: causal power / capacity
evidence: a power or faculty generally

avoid: flattening distinct senses into one gloss
notes: Capitalise Power only when hypostasised (style guide §3).

senses.label: mantra-body / mudrā
evidence: the khecarī-mudrā, the body-of-the-mantra

avoid: translating away the technical mudrā sense

senses.label: consideration / reflection
evidence: ordinary sense

senses.label: reflexive awareness / self-grasping
evidence: ĪPK 1.5.11–13; the reflexive self-articulation of consciousness, without which appearance is crystal-like

avoid: reducing the Pratyabhijñā technical sense to mere 'reflection'

senses.label: manifestation / luminous self-revealing
evidence: the prakāśa–vimarśa pair; the self-revealing light of consciousness

senses.label: vibration / self-motion of consciousness
evidence: the Spanda-current; interior dynamism as the real power

senses.label: consciousness (the ultimate)
evidence: consciousness as the supreme reality

avoid: capitalising Consciousness unless it is the doctrinal absolute (style guide §3)

senses.label: reflexive grasp / assuming into oneself
evidence: the self-grasping of consciousness that constitutes objects

senses.label: freedom / spontaneity of the absolute
evidence: the unconditional freedom of consciousness

senses.label: emission, the kaulikī śakti
evidence: visarga = kaulikī śakti (TĀ 3.143)

senses.label: the mother-of-phonemes / the fifty letters
evidence: the fifty-varṇa power; the mālinī; TĀ 3–4

senses.label: the Mothers (the goddesses)
evidence: the mātṛkā as a class of goddesses

avoid: confusing the phonemic matrix with the goddesses

senses.label: raising / articulation (of the breath-mantra)
evidence: the uccāra as a meditational raising; cross-checked with the Spanda uccāra/āveśa

senses.label: entry / possession
evidence: rudraśaktisamāveśa in the Timirodghāṭana; possession by the Power of Rudra

senses.label: the void (as a station / realization)
evidence: śūnya as a meditational-cosmological station

avoid: over-importing Buddhist śūnyatā into Śaiva usage without evidence
